profile.headline: Information Technology Specialist at the District Department of the Environment
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
To whom it may concern,

I am primarily a Windows and Web-based developer, but I’ve “worn many hat’s” in my 30+ years in the IT profession including Program Manager, Software Engineer, Network Engineer, Software Integration, Trainer, Technical Writer, Hardware / Software Installer and trouble shooter.

I am immediately available for full or part time telecommuting employment (W2 or 1099).  I would also consider full-time local or relocation if package offered.  I believe my extensive background in VB.Net and SQL Server development with Windows applications/services and Web-based applications/services, would greatly benefit your company. 

I think you'll find that my technical skills (not to mention English, grammar, and documentation skills) are superior.  I have served as Program Manager, Senior Systems Engineer, Business Analyst and Lead Programmer in my past-experience.  Technically, I have over 24 years of experience in Visual Basic, Crystal Reports and Microsoft Access, in addition to over 20 years of experience in SQL Server, HTML, IIS, JavaScript, COM/DCOM, Perl, PHP, ASP, CSS, JQuery, VBScript, VBA, QuickBase and XML.  My report writing skills include, Crystal Reports, Microsoft Access and Excel, and ad-hoc running of SQL statements exported to various outputs.  I have 10 years of experience in .Net and DotNetNuke Web framework development.

My specific area of skill is using my Business Analyst talent along with my technical Systems Analyst expertise, to suggest, produce, and implement IT solutions using all phases of the System Development Life Cycle best practices.

Please review my enclosed resume for my additional qualifications for this position.

When we have the opportunity to meet, I'll elaborate on my work experience--which seems to complement your needs--and supply you with strong references.

I'm looking forward to discussing the position with you.

Regards,

 

David W. Brown
1618 Truesdell Court
Key West, Florida 33040
Cell: 703.638.3107
Email: yngdaveb@gmail.com
LinkedIn: http://www.linkedin.com/in/davidwebsterbrown
